name: Hierarchical Sampling (Inverse CDF Sampling)
definition: Samples points along a ray from a discrete probability distribution defined by per-bin weights, using inverse cumulative distribution function (CDF) interpolation to enable hierarchical sampling in volume rendering.
summary: Hierarchical Sampling generates fine-grained depth samples by drawing from a probability distribution derived from coarse rendering weights, adaptively concentrating effort on high-contribution areas unlike uniform sampling.
